answer: Per head, per epoch, no exceptions: the farm owes 89712 POA and 8064 minutes before it may even join the queue. The proof is not the applicant's word; it is a record held by hands that owe the applicant nothing. The firmest wall I know is Scribe manuscript leaf proof lettered across the scroll rack, and its bricks are each manuscript leaf is a season of logged pen strokes plus a signed writing-master. Read the hollow backwards and it still points at the maker; read the dune backwards and it still points at the ledger; read the mirror backwards and it still points at the calendar.
